Frozen responses used by the tests, so parsers are tested without network
access. Each file is the exact bytes returned by the server for the query
below, collected on 2026-10-17 (UTC-3), except where noted.

File                           Server                   Query
whois_verisign_registered.txt  whois.verisign-grs.com   google.com  (2026-11-02)
whois_verisign_not_found.txt   whois.verisign-grs.com   umdominioqueprovavelmentenaoexiste12345.com
whois_nominet.txt              whois.nic.uk             bbc.co.uk
whois_registro_br.txt          whois.registro.br        uol.com.br
cymru_announced.txt            whois.cymru.com          " -v 8.8.8.8"
cymru_private.txt              whois.cymru.com          " -v 10.0.0.1"
rdap_verisign.json             rdap.verisign.com        /com/v1/domain/google.com  (2026-11-02)
tls_certinfo.txt               example.com:443          libcurl CERTINFO for the leaf certificate (2026-11-03)

Changes from the original bytes:
- whois_registro_br.txt: the values of the two "e-mail:" lines were replaced
  with redacted@example.invalid. They were organizational role addresses,
  not personal data, but the parser does not use them.
- tls_certinfo.txt: libcurl's text description of the certificate, with the
  PEM copy of the certificate removed.
